caption: The drawing depicts two views of a rectangular, brown ceramic mold. The top view shows the mold’s interior, which has an octagonal border and fluted sides, with a central design featuring a raised depiction of a fruit motif that resembles a cluster of grapes with a single larger round fruit or possibly a peach or apple and a leaf. The perspective view below shows the exterior and side profile of the mold, emphasizing its trapezoidal shape, smooth sides, and the inner fluted detailing around the upper edge. The colors used are primarily shades of brown and beige, giving the ceramic a glazed appearance, and the background is a plain, off-white color. The drawing is annotated at the lower left with the words "actual size," and at the lower right with the artist’s name and the year "Howard H. Sherwin, 1936."
title: Crockery Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
